pages.title: Mugger Crocodile
pages.text: The mugger crocodile ($(o)Crocodylus palustris$()) lives in the rivers, lakes and marshes of India and neighbouring countries.$(br2)It has the broadest snout of any living crocodile, and eats fish, birds and mammals.$(br2)In dry seasons it digs burrows to shelter from the heat.

pages.title: Mugger Crocodile
